evidence: Changes RPC help text in src/rpc/net.cpp and fixes a counter wraparound in bitcoin-cli in src/bitcoin-cli.cpp
rationale: Fixes a minor display wraparound bug in bitcoin-cli -netinfo and clarifies RPC documentation. The manual peer counter in -netinfo was uint8_t and could wrap at 256, and the addnode help text did not specify that the connection cap applies only to persistent add entries rather than onetry.
